tutorial_tips.doc: M2-UI-24 (intro audit 2): first-time tips in the field. Each tip shows once per save: its seen 'flag' (declared in game/data/flags.tres) is set when it shows. 'on' is what raises it: 'field_ready' (the field takes input in a scene), 'near' (an interactable comes in reach whose tags include 'tag': its payload's keys, plus 'shrine' for a save shrine), or 'flag' (story flag 'when' becomes true). 'requires' flags must all be set. Text is title_key and body_key; a body may name bindings as {action} (an InputMap action), shown by the first key's name, or the first pad button's after the pad was used. Tips queue, one at a time. The card sits at 'panel' (x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference; it grows for long text; its top sits below the area title's band, area_title.json, since both show when the field first takes input and a long name such as Corrow's night runs under it otherwise), fades over fade_sec, and stays hold_sec plus sec_per_char for each body character. It never shows while the field refuses input or a menu pauses the tree (a tip raised then waits), and the Accessibility setting 'tutorial_tips' turns them all off (raised tips are then dropped, not saved as seen). pad_deadzone: stick motion under it does not count as using the pad (for the bindings a body names). Ch1's own story prompts (ch01_field.json 'prompts') are separate. The Lead's first-hour pass (2026-10-30): 'when' may list flags (any raises it) and 'requires_any' asks one of its flags, so the Act I route (ch01_started, Ch1's first win) and the slice's both teach; pressing an action a tip's body names fades it out (TipCard.dismiss). Act II (M4-A2P-1702, act2-plan's ui/tutorials.md): the objective tip comes at Ch1's bell room (a Ch1 field_ready fires in the fade-in, before ch01_started is set: M4-A2P-1004 F5); Seven heroes, Records and Dark shrines; Swell mode waits for Progression's unlock flags.
